label: Cottage cheese
comment: Granular, cooked and washed, then dressed with cream: its own route to a fresh cheese.

about.text: A soft, unripened, rindless cheese of separate, near-white curd grains about 3–12 mm across, made from skimmed milk that is soured, cut and cooked, then usually mixed with a cream dressing.

links.name: Codex Standard for Cottage Cheese, CXS 273-1968

facts.v: Codex 3–12 mm; small curd under 4 mm, large curd over 8 mm (Wikipedia)
Cold skim milk is acidified with vinegar, citric or lactic acid, which roughly halves the time (Wikipedia)

picks.why: The US cottage cheese is the type's global archetype, a mass-produced fresh curd eaten worldwide.
The washed, cream-free curd base of American cottage cheese, defined by a legal US standard of identity.
Finland's everyday cottage cheese, widely sold across the Nordic countries as a staple fresh cheese.
A spiced version of Ethiopia's ayib, a central cottage-type cheese of Ethiopian cuisine.
Croatia's Zagorje cottage cheese, eaten with cream and used in the region's celebrated štrukli.
